body:
GBM test8 - Android startup repair

Fixed repeated engine database open retries during startup by storing rebuildable native engine state on Android internal app storage. Foreground and VPN services use the same private directory. Existing account databases and subscription config paths remain intact.

Includes visible startup progress and failure recovery, bounded local handshake, and Skia rendering compatibility.

Version 5.5.10 (50510). Release/AOT build signed with the existing test certificate; legacy asset names remain compatible with the updater.

The exact x86_64 APK is checked with three cold launches on the Android emulator. This does not constitute ARM64 physical-device, payment, or production VPN end-to-end testing. Private source is maintained separately from this public distribution repository.
